bullets.text: Chennai cops whisked away and humiliated economist A Kalaiyarasan from his Adyar residence over a fake social media post, and the office should monitor police accountability.
Ponneri municipality refused to collect waste from a local panchayat leaving it struggling for dumping space, and the district team should watch for sanitation escalations.
Gummidipoondi traders detained a highways department vehicle over footpath disputes, and the office must track local administrative friction.
KONE Centennial Foundation funded educational expenses for 38 underprivileged children at Sevalaya in Tiruvallur, and the team should note this welfare support.
L&T's Vyoma.AI performed the groundbreaking ceremony for its Chennai data centre project, and the portfolio team should track infrastructure development progress.
Noida Authority approved the AI City-cum-business park plan and IT land schemes, and the department should watch national tech hub expansions.

stories.title: Cops whisk away, humiliate economist over fake social media post
takeaways: Chennai-based economist A Kalaiyarasan was whisked away from his Adyar residence by cops over a social media post.
The early-morning incident raises severe concerns about law enforcement conduct and freedom of expression within the constituency.

stories.title: KONE Centennial Foundation visits Sevalaya in Tiruvallur
takeaways: KONE Centennial Foundation donated five lakh rupees to sponsor educational expenses of thirty eight children in Tiruvallur.
The international funding helps secure one year of academic support for underprivileged students at the Sevalaya institution.

This marks a competitive national development in AI infrastructure that policymakers in Tamil Nadu should monitor.
